name: Moto E20

images.credit: EEIM, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (rear-mounted), Proximity sensor, accelerometer, water-repellent coating

Platform.Chipset: E20: Unisoc T606 (12 nm), E30/E40: Unisoc T700 (12 nm)
Platform.CPU: E20: Octa-core (2×1.6 GHz Cortex-A75 & 6×1.6 GHz Cortex-A55), E30/E40: Octa-core (2×1.82 GHz Cortex-A75 & 6×1.82 GHz Cortex-A55)

Memory.RAM: E20: 2/3 GB, E30: 2 GB, E40: 4 GB, LPDDR4X

Display.Display: All models: IPS LCD, 6.5", 1600 × 720 (HD+), 20:9 aspect ratio, 270 ppi, E20: 60 Hz, E30 & E40: 90 Hz

Cameras.Rear camera: E20: 13 MP, 26 mm (wide), PDAF + 2 MP, (macro), E30: 48 MP, 26 mm, (wide), 1/2.0", 0.8 µm, PDAF + 2 MP, (macro) + 2 MP, (depth sensor), E40: 48 MP, 26 mm, (wide), PDAF + 2 MP, (macro) + 2 MP, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps
Cameras.Front camera: E20: 5 MP, E30/E40: 8 MP, 26 mm (wide), 1/4", 1.12 µm, HDR, Video: 1080p@30fps

Battery.Battery: All models: Non-removable, Li-Po, E20: 4000 mAh, E30 & E40: 5000 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, 3.5 mm Audio jack, Bluetooth 5.0 (A2DP, LE), FM radio, Wi-Fi 802.11 a (E30)/b/g/n (except E30) (hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS (except E20), Galileo (except E20)
